description: This file implements a class for managing cache tag invalidation checksums using a database in Drupal. It includes methods for invalidating tags, retrieving invalidation counts, purging cache, and ensuring the cache tags table exists.

classes.name: DatabaseCacheTagsChecksum
classes.description: Implements cache tags invalidation checksum management using a database in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with a database connection.

methods.name: doInvalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates specified cache tags by incrementing their invalidation count.

methods.name: getTagInvalidationCounts
methods.description: Retrieves invalidation counts for specified cache tags.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges all cache tags by truncating the cachetags table.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the cachetags table exists and creates it if not.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the cachetags table.
